targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" or r._measurement == "http_req_failed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["group"] != "::setup")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["group"] != "::teardown")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["buildId"] =~ /${buildId:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["release"] =~ /${release:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["testName"] =~ /${testName:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["scenario"] =~ /${scenario:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["name"])

quantile_result = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration")
  |> quantile(q: 0.90, method: "exact_mean")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with "Percentile 90th (ms)": r._value}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_value", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])

mean_result = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration")
  |> mean(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with "Avg Request Time (ms)": r._value}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_value", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])

count_result = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration")
  |> count(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with "Requests count": r._value}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_value", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])

failure_result = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed")
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with "Failures": r._value}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_value", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])

p95_result = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration")
  |> quantile(q: 0.95, method: "exact_mean")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with "Percentile 95th (ms)": r._value}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_value", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])

longest_result = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration")
  |> max(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with "Longest Request (ms)": r._value}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_value", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])

shortest_result = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration")
  |> min(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with "Shortest Request (ms)": r._value}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_value", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])

quantile_mean_join = join(tables: {quantile: quantile_result, mean: mean_result}, on: ["name"])
quantile_mean_count_join = join(tables: {quantile_mean: quantile_mean_join, count: count_result}, on: ["name"])
failures_join = join(tables: {quantile_mean_count: quantile_mean_count_join, failures: failure_result}, on: ["name"])
p95_join = join(tables: {failures_join: failures_join, p95: p95_result}, on: ["name"])
longest_join = join(tables: {p95_join: p95_join, longest: longest_result}, on: ["name"])
final_result = join(tables: {longest_join: longest_join, shortest: shortest_result}, on: ["name"])

final_result
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "Requests count", "Percentile 90th (ms)", "Avg Request Time (ms)", "Failures", "Percentile 95th (ms)", "Longest Request (ms)", "Shortest Request (ms)"])
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> yield(name: "request_stats")
